notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YSKmdP4OYSU;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Ym1KLHN8fL8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b][h3]Wolves and Penguins[/h3][/b][/i]
With the release of update 1.0.6 - Early Access, we introduce two new additions to the fauna of our survival world. Wolves and Penguins can now be tamed, providing players with the opportunity to have loyal companions on their journeys. Wolves not only become reliable protectors but also emit alert howls whenever aggressive enemies approach, adding an extra layer of security for players.

On the other hand, Penguins, apart from their adorable nature, also play a crucial role in survival. When sent to rivers, they gather fish, ensuring a steady supply of fresh food. Additionally, the presence of Penguins and other sources of warmth around helps reduce the sensation of cold, safeguarding players during lower temperatures.

[i]Once tamed, both animals can be given commands to follow, stop, attack, target an enemy, or move to a specific location. Check the input settings to configure the keys according to your preferred usage.[/i]

[h2][b]Implementations:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a seasonal cold system, affecting the character during the winter season.
[*] Implemented temperature reduction for the player near heat sources and domesticated penguins.
[*] Revamped the number of missions and difficulties for a more balanced gameplay experience.
[*] Reduced fishing time for a more dynamic interaction.
[*] Replaced the presence of bears, komodos, and crocodiles with wolves and penguins during snowy periods.
[*] Increased animal detection range, providing a more challenging player detection experience.
[*] Enhanced the amount of water consumed by the player when interacting with rivers.
[*] Balanced effects of consuming different types of meat for a more consistent experience.
[*] Added an option to disable motion blur in the game settings.
[*] Updated item descriptions for better player comprehension.
[*] King Skeleton Helmet now provides 50% resistance to all types of damage.
[*] Streamlined plant cultivation process for a more engaging and agile farming experience.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed construction errors.
[*] Resolved irregular placement issue of water storage on uneven terrains.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the king skeleton helmet to disappear when picked up with a full inventory.
[*] Addressed behavior of domesticated animals attacking players after being fed.
[*] Rectified the ritual sacrifice error to ensure proper mechanics functionality.
[*] Eliminated animal accumulation bug occurring when loading the game multiple times.
[*] Fixed progress-saving issue when constructing the raft in progress.
[/list]

[i]I greatly appreciate the players who have devoted their time to reporting bugs and providing feedback, contributing to the improvement of our game. Your assistance is essential in shaping the project's future and ensuring a more engaging and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. Thank you for being part of our player community![/i]

[i]Note: I recommend that you restart a new game, so that problems that have already been fixed do not continue to occur.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Early Access
notes.content:
[i][b][h2]Changelog - Update 1.0.3 - Early Access[/h2][/b][/i]

[b][h2]Fixes:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue causing the ancestral spirit to not appear after completing all rituals, ensuring a complete and consistent game experience.
[/list]

[b][h2]Implementations:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Now it's possible to bury the bodies of indigenous NPCs, offering a new mechanic to avoid future conflicts with other indigenous characters.
[*] Increased the death loot duration to 10 minutes, providing players with more time to recover their belongings after death.
[*] Added 7 pre-defined custom animations, from F1 to F7, which can be assigned to personalized input commands in the settings.
[*] Included a new input settings slot in the menu for first-person camera, allowing players to customize the viewing experience according to their preferences.
[*] Implemented the feature of an ancestral spirit spawning at the character's death location, providing a thematic and emotionally-rich aspect to the game.
[*] Automatic game save to the Steam cloud has been added, ensuring that players don't lose their progress.
[/list]

[i]We remain committed to improving the Early Access experience of the game, and this update brings significant fixes and implementations to make the gameplay more engaging and complete. We appreciate all players who provided feedback and helped identify the issues that were addressed in this update.

We hope these changes further enrich your journey in "Native Hunter". Keep enjoying the game and stay tuned for more exciting updates in the future![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Early Access
notes.content:
[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of Flint getting stuck in the ground.
[*] Renamed the bed option to "Claim Bed" and "Unclaim Bed" to avoid confusion.
[*] Adjusted the mission order, now the mortar mission appears after the workbench.
[*] And some other small fixes.
[/list]

[h2][b]Implementations:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the functionality to build shooting targets. Players can now create targets at the workbench to practice their aiming skills.
[*] Introduced the drop of pistons in ship barrels. Players now have a chance to find pistons when looting barrels on ships.
[*] Improved the way wood is dropped from trees. The drop system has been enhanced, ensuring a smoother and more realistic experience.
[*] Increased the drop rate of wood when cutting down trees. Players will now receive more wood when harvesting trees, making it easier to build their bases and vessels.
[*] Added the option to close windows using the ESC key. Players can now close inventory and interaction windows by pressing the ESC key for added convenience.
[/list]

[i][b]We are constantly working to improve the gaming experience, and this update brings important bug fixes and implementations for the Early Access version of the game. We appreciate all players who provided feedback and helped us identify the issues that have been addressed in this update.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Native Hunter now available!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Join the Epic Expedition![/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Explore a Stunning World:[/b] Embrace the freedom of a vast open world, where nature reveals itself in its most breathtaking form. From lush forests to majestic mountains and sun-kissed beaches, immerse yourself in captivating and vibrant landscapes.
[*] [b]Advanced Crafting and Building:[/b] Master the art of crafting and building to survive and thrive in hostile environments. Gather natural resources and forge equipment, weapons, and useful structures to face the challenges that lie ahead.
[*] [b]Creature Taming:[/b] Befriend the local fauna and experience the wonders of creature taming. Increase your chances of survival by recruiting animals as allies, each with unique abilities to assist you on your journey.
[*] [b]Farm System:[/b] Cultivate the land and reap the rewards of your labor. Agriculture will be vital to ensure a steady supply of essential resources for your survival and growth.
[*] [b]Challenging Combat:[/b] Prepare to face relentless adversaries! Hone your combat skills and strategies to confront natural threats and formidable enemies inhabiting this untamed world.
[*] [b]Sea Navigation:[/b] Venture across the oceans on customizable vessels, uncover secrets hidden on mysterious islands!
[/list]
